CFML Language Reference: Functions

CreateObject

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

The function form of CFOBJECT: creates an instance of a COM component, a CORBA object or a Java class and returns it, so that you can call its methods and read its properties.

Category

System functions

Syntax

CreateObject("COM", class [, context [, servername ] ])
CreateObject("CORBA", context, class [, locale ])
CreateObject("JAVA", class)

Parameters

type
"COM", "CORBA" or "JAVA".
class
COM: the ProgID of the component, such as "Word.Application". CORBA: the IOR file name or the naming service name. Java: the full class name, such as "java.util.Vector".
context
COM: "InProc", "Local" or "Remote". CORBA: "IOR" or "NameService".
servername
COM with context "Remote": the server running the component.
locale
CORBA: arguments for the ORB.

Returns

The object.

Usage

Note  KoldFusion for UNIX cannot create objects. COM is a Windows NT technology, no CORBA ORB is bundled and no Java virtual machine is configured, so every call throws an exception of type Object. Wrap calls in CFTRY/CFCATCH as shown, so a page written for the Windows server degrades gracefully.

Use JavaCast to choose between overloaded Java methods.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Kinds = "COM|Word.Application,JAVA|java.util.Vector">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>CreateObject()</TH><TH>Result</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP LIST="#Kinds#" INDEX="k">
  <CFSET Result = "Created">
  <CFTRY>
    <CFSET Obj = CreateObject(ListFirst(k, "|"), ListLast(k, "|"))>
  <CFCATCH TYPE="Object">
    <CFSET Result = "<I>#CFCATCH.Message#</I>">
  </CFCATCH>
  </CFTRY>
  <CFOUTPUT><TR><TD>"#ListFirst(k, "|")#", "#ListLast(k, "|")#"</TD><TD>#Result#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
